resources.string: Generate a workout plan split by days of the week for %1$s%2$s. User context (goal, anthropometric measurements, and history): %3$s. Organize the exercises specified by day (e.g., Day 1, Day 2, etc.) and include clear execution instructions. IMPORTANT: Respond in the language used in the user\'s context/system locale. Respond in plain JSON format with this exact structure: { "title": "Plan title", "goal": "Description of the objective and split by days", "exercises": [ { "day": 1, "name": "Exercise name with execution notes", "muscleGroup": "Muscle Group", "sets": 3, "reps": "10-12", "rest": 60 } ] }

Provide a relevant YouTube video URL and an image URL for performing the exercise \'%1$s\'. IMPORTANT: Respond in the language of the user context. Respond in plain JSON format with this exact structure without any other text: { "videoUrl": "https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=...", "imageUrl": "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1517838277536-f5f99be501cd" }
